svg.title: RIEMANN · MAP F3 — The proof as code: the blueprint's nine chapters against the formalisation's modules, and what each statement stands for in Lean
svg.desc: lean-facts.json is the blueprint's index of the formal proof: one entry for each of the 1194 Lean declarations a statement names, with its kind, module, file and lines. Every declaration is named by exactly one statement, and 413 of the 416 statements name at least one. This poster reads the index the other way round. The matrix puts the chapters of the blueprint against the modules of the formalisation, so that the paper's organisation and the code's can be compared: they are not the same tree. The cards are the formalisation's own tree, namespace by namespace, as far as the index sees it. The tables give each chapter's footprint in the code and the fan-out from one statement to the declarations it stands for. The index covers what the blueprint names, not the whole formalisation; what a declaration proves, and whether it is proved, is not in it. No Lean was built: see diagram R1, band 5. Map mode: this poster quotes nothing in either form.

text.tspan: The proof as code: the blueprint's nine chapters against the formalisation's modules, and what each statement stands for in Lean

svg.text: lean-facts.json is the blueprint's index of the formal proof: one entry for each of the 1194 Lean declarations a statement names, with its kind, module, file and lines. Every declaration is named by exactly one statement, and 413 of the 416 statements name at least one. This poster reads the index the other way round. The matrix puts the chapters of the blueprint against the modules of the formalisation, so that the paper's organisation and the code's can be

compared: they are not the same tree. The cards are the formalisation's own tree, namespace by namespace, as far as the index sees it. The tables give each chapter's footprint in the code and the fan-out from one statement to the declarations it stands for. The index covers what the blueprint names, not the whole formalisation; what a declaration proves, and whether it is proved, is not in it. No Lean was built: see diagram R1, band 5. Map mode: this poster

A module is a Lean file; its dotted name is its path under src/. The matrix groups declarations by the first two parts of that name, the namespace and the theory under it, and the cards go one part deeper. A module is one file, so modules and files count the same; a file may hold several declarations.

A cell of the matrix counts the declarations in that module that statements of that chapter name. The last column counts the statements doing the naming. Where a chapter's row is spread across many modules, the paper's chapter is drawn from several theories of the code; where a module's column is spread across
chapters, one theory of the code serves several chapters.
Lines spanned is the sum of each declaration's line range in its file, as the index records it: the size of the declarations themselves, not of the proofs they depend on.

Fan-out is how many declarations one statement names. A statement that names two usually names a definition and a theorem, the pattern diagram R1 shows for the five theorems of Main.lean: a Prop and the theorem that proves it. The index records the pairing; it does not say which is which.
1194 declarations in 953 modules and 953 files, spanning 14,833 lines: 827 theorems, 326 definitions, 40 structures, 1 inductives.
10 namespaces: Development 970, Formalism 164, ReciprocityTheory 20, CompanionTheory 18, GroundTheory 6, Main 5, Statements 4, Supplements 4, PositivityTheory 2, Mathlib 1.
35 theories at the second level; the three largest, Development.AbelianVarietyTheory (460), Development.AutomorphicArithmetic (327), Development.WeilBound (134), hold 77% of the
413 of 416 statements name a declaration; the three that do not are rem-local-parameters-weak, rem-points-to-check, thm-theta-inputs. Each declaration is named by one statement; none is
Fan-out: 3 name 0, 55 name 1, 200 name 2, 56 name 3, 52 name 4, 20 name 5, 13 name 6, 4 name 7, 5 name 8, 1 name 9, 1 name 10, 1 name 11, 1 name 13, 1 name 15, 2 name 18, 1 name 23. Of the
200 that name two, 130 name a definition and a theorem, 66 name two theorems, 2 name two definitions, 1 name two structures, 1 name a structure and a theorem.
One declaration carries a docstring in the index: RiemannHypothesis.

Rows: the formalisation's modules to the second level, grouped by namespace, largest first. Columns: the blueprint's chapters in its order. A cell counts the declarations of that module named by statements of that chapter.
